name: bergbahnen.li
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But the viewport stops people from zooming.
lesson: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable=no from the viewport tag. People need to zoom.
summary: www.bergbahnen.li scores 71 out of 100 (C). 6 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 36 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /meta/webcams, /sommer/tickets-preise, for example #toggle-dropdown-weather-forecast and #toggle-mega-menu-1342. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /meta/webcams, /sommer/tickets-preise, for example li:nth-child(2) > a[target=""] and a[href$="agb"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: 23 images are not served as WebP or AVIF
fix.evidence: veranstaltungskalener-malbun-65c5d886ab… on / (PNG, 964 KB), veranstaltungskalender-august-k-bum-46f… on / (PNG, 874 KB), k-bum-goes-sareis-6cdb5c9796690ea61530e… on / (PNG, 872 KB), tarife_02_Sommer-498_Kopie.jpeg on /sommer/tickets-preise (JPEG, 561 KB)…
fix.fix: Serve WebP or AVIF through the CDN or image service, or with <picture> and a JPEG or PNG fallback.

fix.title: 21 images are more than twice the size shown
fix.evidence: tarife_02_Sommer-498_Kopie.jpeg on /sommer/tickets-preise (1920×1280 shown at 490×327, 561 KB, about 415 KB to save), genusssesselbahn_9745.jpg on /sommer/tickets-preise (1920×1280 shown at 490×327, 466 KB, about 344 KB to save), Sommer-Gutschein-HP.jpeg on…
fix.fix: Resize images to at most twice the width they are shown at, and give phones smaller files with srcset and sizes.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Nothing on the page blocks the back/forward cache
Every external link that was checked answered
